items.invariant: Gate F uses only the frozen M6_4_HOT_CLOSE and M6_4_ACTION_SMOKE purpose constants, and the single pre-send HOT_CLOSE scenario has exactly zero transport and zero actions.
forbiddenDependencies: generic ZERO_OR_ONE as the sole HOT_CLOSE verifier

probes.procedure: Validate exact manifests and aggregates after mutating purpose, cardinality, transportCount, actionCount, scenario ID and failure-closeout linkage.
probes.preFixExpected: A wrong purpose or counter-one HOT_CLOSE can pass the generic aggregate.
probes.postFixExpected: Only exact purpose/cardinality records pass and HOT_CLOSE requires transportCount=0 and actionCount=0 with the bound failure closeout.
probes.pathExercise: The probe invokes the production cohort validator used by the canary closeout, not a test-only duplicate.

probes.procedure: Regenerate all cohort manifests, compare exact hashes, and re-run the closeout validator over the frozen 5/1/3/20/30 cardinalities.
probes.preFixExpected: Purpose or verifier drift changes bytes or accepts the wrong run set.
probes.postFixExpected: Manifest hashes reproduce and every purpose has the exact fixed denominator and no extras.
probes.pathExercise: The generator and verifier consume the committed artifacts later bound into live authorization.

items.invariant: A live window is authorized only by a canonical Ed25519-signed owner envelope bound to exact runtime values and atomically consumed once at the current gate generation.
forbiddenDependencies: private signing key in repository, runtime, log, receipt or model packet
authorization generation before exact release/profile/environment hashes exist

probes.procedure: Change release, 40-hex source commit, epoch, generation, purpose, manifest, model, provider, tool, policy, locks, environment, alias, operator, emergency-close or expiry after signing.
probes.preFixExpected: At least one runtime drift is accepted by a shape-only validator.
probes.postFixExpected: Every drift rejects before gate activation or action counter increment.
probes.pathExercise: Runner, sealed broker and Control Plane verifier each consume the same canonical signed body and current runtime snapshot.

probes.procedure: Submit unsigned, wrong-key, revoked-key, altered-body and self-issued live-window envelopes.
probes.preFixExpected: A locally fabricated JSON record can pass.
probes.postFixExpected: Only an active allowlisted owner key verifies; no authorization or resource row is created for a forgery.
probes.pathExercise: The test uses the production trusted issuer verifier with ephemeral test-only keys.

probes.procedure: Consume one nonce at one gate generation, then retry it concurrently and after generation change/restart.
probes.preFixExpected: The same envelope can activate or authorize twice.
probes.postFixExpected: The StateStore unique consumption and generation CAS reject every replay durably.
probes.pathExercise: Two processes reopen the same database and race the production atomic-consume API.

probes.procedure: Recompute canonical signing bytes, body hash, envelope hash and all referenced runtime hashes from committed/release artifacts.
probes.preFixExpected: A hash cannot be independently regenerated or references unresolved values.
probes.postFixExpected: All bytes and hashes reproduce exactly without private material.
probes.pathExercise: The verifier reads the exact signed envelope, public-key allowlist and sealed release inventory.

items.invariant: The pure M6-C1 main-built release exposes one internal alias-01 live path through a sealed provider and inherited-pipe broker while the child holds exactly ten opaque tools and no raw authority.
forbiddenDependencies: raw ADB, port, coordinate, DB, lease, payment or delete authority in the child
fixture or replay provider as live proof
M6-5 code in the M6-C1 canary release

probes.procedure: Launch the production child path with wrong alias/process/session/run, extra tool, raw field, pipe replay, descendant handle, stale environment and unqualified profile.
probes.preFixExpected: An unsealed or rebound child reaches a live tool or retains authority.
probes.postFixExpected: Every invalid launch rejects fail-closed with zero action and all processes/pipes/resources close.
probes.pathExercise: The probe starts a real DSH child through the same parent broker and bootstrap used by the release.

probes.procedure: Build the pure M6-C1 release from the merged main commit and recompute source, release, locks, model, provider, tool, policy and environment hashes.
probes.preFixExpected: The release includes untracked code, M6-5 scope or an unresolved profile/hash.
probes.postFixExpected: The release inventory is closed, main-built, M6-C1-only and every referenced hash reproduces.
probes.pathExercise: The release builder and runtime loader verify the same manifest installed on the target host.

items.invariant: M6-4 completes only after exact alias-01 5/1/3/20/30 cohorts close under independent effect oracles, the gate returns CLOSED and all jobs, sessions, leases, approvals, actions and DSH processes are reconciled to zero.
forbiddenDependencies: skipped, replacement, supplemental or extra scenario
public, social, account, security, settings, draft, payment or delete effect

probes.procedure: Inject wrong query/page/result/ad classification, stale frame, duplicate action, unknown counter-one result, forbidden effect and emergency-close races across the fixed cohorts.
probes.preFixExpected: An unsafe or incomplete run can contribute success or leave the gate/resources open.
probes.postFixExpected: The entire affected window fails, emergency-closes and produces a truthful failure closeout with no blind retry.
probes.pathExercise: The live runner, independent oracle, gate promoter, ledger and resource probe all contribute bound evidence.

probes.procedure: Compare each run to pre-window expected query, page, non-ad result, note reference, forbidden/public effect and reset records authored outside the SUT trace.
probes.preFixExpected: UI intent or ledger success can stand in for business truth.
probes.postFixExpected: Only independently observed expected outcomes count; all forbidden/public deltas are zero and bounded read traces are reset or explicitly retained.
probes.pathExercise: The oracle reads independent account/device/backend sources and verifies their frozen hashes.

probes.procedure: Corrupt one expected record, completion receipt, cohort cardinality, resource count and CLOSED epoch reference.
probes.preFixExpected: Aggregate success remains green despite corrupted evidence.
probes.postFixExpected: Every mutation invalidates the completion receipt.
probes.pathExercise: The completion verifier consumes all exact artifacts rather than an aggregate boolean.

probes.procedure: Recompute every cohort aggregate, receipt, gate chain, resource probe and final action-canary completion hash.
probes.preFixExpected: At least one artifact or exact denominator cannot be reproduced.
probes.postFixExpected: All hashes and counts reproduce and the terminal claim is exactly M6_4_ACTION_CANARY_CLOSED.
probes.pathExercise: The reproduction starts from immutable run/ledger/oracle records and current CLOSED tail.

items.invariant: Live worker checkpoints are opaque-ref-only, crash-consistent, content-addressed records whose journal prefix and profile/tool/policy bindings reproduce; they never become action authority.
forbiddenDependencies: secret, raw transport, coordinate, ADB, port, token, DB path, payment parameter or screenshot base64

probes.procedure: Inject truncate, malformed JSON, extra field, journal gap, hash/profile/tool/policy drift, cross-run replay, symlink/junction and crash at every write/fsync/rename boundary.
probes.preFixExpected: A corrupt or rebound checkpoint resumes or escapes the canonical root.
probes.postFixExpected: Every corruption fails closed and the last fully durable checkpoint remains readable without action dispatch.
probes.pathExercise: Tests exercise the production checkpoint store and reopen it in a separate process.

probes.procedure: Regenerate a checkpoint from the durable journal prefix and compare canonical bytes, state hash, journal hash and referenced artifacts.
probes.preFixExpected: Checkpoint bytes or bindings cannot be regenerated exactly.
probes.postFixExpected: Every byte and hash reproduces and secret/raw scans remain empty.
probes.pathExercise: The verifier independently reads the committed schema, journal and content-addressed refs.

items.invariant: A logical action keeps one global claim and immutable append-only physical attempt generations; only independently PROVEN_NOT_SENT counter-zero evidence can create one fresh generation with new frame, decision, permit and typed authorization.
forbiddenDependencies: changed operationKey, actionId or slot authority
old frame, decision, permit, auth or environment reuse
cross-generation raw dispatch total above one

probes.procedure: Race two reconcilers across crash/restart and mutate generation, slot, evidence, current pointer and cumulative counters.
probes.preFixExpected: A second claim, stale authority or two physical dispatches can be created.
probes.postFixExpected: CAS selects at most one fresh generation and the independent cumulative raw counter stays at most one.
probes.pathExercise: The probe uses two StateStore instances over the same durable database and the production reconciler.

probes.procedure: Forge PROVEN_NOT_SENT evidence, broker counter, typed-adapter counter and attempt-history hashes.
probes.preFixExpected: A fabricated counter-zero claim re-arms the action.
probes.postFixExpected: Cross-bound evidence integrity rejects before a new generation or authorization is created.
probes.pathExercise: The reconciler verifies separately persisted ledger, broker and adapter evidence.

probes.procedure: Replay old permit/auth/nonces and a previously finalized generation after restart.
probes.preFixExpected: Old authority can reach transport again.
probes.postFixExpected: Consumed/expired authority and finalized generations reject durably.
probes.pathExercise: The test reopens the database and invokes the same production consume APIs.

probes.procedure: Recompute all attempt-history rows, generation chain hashes, reconcile decisions and cumulative counter evidence.
probes.preFixExpected: A transition or physical attempt is missing from the chain.
probes.postFixExpected: The full history reproduces without deleting or rewriting prior generations.
probes.pathExercise: The verifier reads append-only rows and independently derives the current generation.

items.invariant: A counter-one action is never resent and becomes determinate only through a pre-dispatch, independently authored expected-state artifact and an observer independent of ledger, transport, broker, model and SUT receipts.
forbiddenDependencies: ledger, transport result, broker ack, model narrative or GroundedActionReceipt as business truth

probes.procedure: Compare independently frozen expected state with after-state collected by a separate observer for each fault scenario.
probes.preFixExpected: Counter-one transport evidence can self-certify success.
probes.postFixExpected: Only independent expected/actual agreement produces RECONCILED_EFFECT or REUSE_VERIFIED; otherwise WAIT_HUMAN_AMBIGUOUS.
probes.pathExercise: The observer and expected artifact are separately instantiated and neither consumes the SUT trace.

probes.procedure: Test ledger/transport success with unchanged business state, changed business state with corrupted ledger, and damaged expected/oracle hashes.
probes.preFixExpected: At least one circular or inconsistent evidence set passes.
probes.postFixExpected: Every inconsistent set fails closed and no dispatch occurs.
probes.pathExercise: The production reconciler receives both forward and reverse mutations.

probes.procedure: Recompute expected artifact, observation and decision hashes for the complete counter-one fault corpus.
probes.preFixExpected: An expected or actual input cannot be independently regenerated.
probes.postFixExpected: All decision inputs and resulting hashes reproduce exactly.
probes.pathExercise: The verifier reads immutable expected and observed artifacts from separate roots.

items.invariant: All seven M6-5 fault families yield a determinate or explicitly ambiguous worker outcome without duplicate/out-of-scope action, preserve RepairTriggered/SkillFinished/receipt/ledger consistency, and close every DSH process, broker, job, session and lease.
forbiddenDependencies: agentic_session enum/router/binder or fabricated M5 WorkReceipt
orphan DSH, pipe, job, session or lease

probes.procedure: Run kill-before-dispatch, kill-after-dispatch-before-result, result-before-checkpoint, empty dump, stale frame, ambiguity/no-progress and serve-unavailable through real DSH processes and the bounded transport/ledger harness.
probes.preFixExpected: A fault duplicates an effect, yields an incorrect scheduler projection or leaks a resource.
probes.postFixExpected: Every family has its exact expected reconcile/outcome/event path, raw dispatch at most one and all resources zero.
probes.pathExercise: The harness uses the production checkpoint, StateStore, reconciler, facade, broker and process supervisor paths.

probes.procedure: Regenerate the fault receipt, event projection, ledger chain, process-close receipts and resource snapshots, then run all M6/M5/M4/kernel/fusion/authority and cross-platform gates.
probes.preFixExpected: A required family, event, receipt, test or resource proof is absent or nondeterministic.
probes.postFixExpected: All seven families and required regression suites reproduce, with only the exact historical Windows symlink EPERM recorded where applicable.
probes.pathExercise: The completion verifier consumes command output hashes and every required artifact rather than a summary claim.
